messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: metric 'invoice_preview_count' deviation detected for the billing pipeline. 5% undercount vs expected baseline across last 2 hours. Auto-created incident thread 1790123456.

Jin (billing-eng): seeing the same in the dashboard — several customers' invoice previews are ~20-30% lower than usage ingest. this looks like a tagging/filter regression in the join query introduced in last deploy. starting investigation.

Katie (oncall): i'm on it — paging now. Omar, can you take infra/ingest side? i can look at billing pipeline and quick rollbacks.

Omar (sre): on pager. tailing the metering producer logs. quick check: kafka consumer group lag is normal, but kafka -> transform worker recently restarted (03:42 UTC), got a config reload. grabbing logs.

Jin (billing-eng): found suspicious change in prod query: `WHERE event_type IN ('token','embed')` got narrowed to `IN ('token')` in 03:41 deploy. suspect filters dropping embed usage. diff attached from deploy: 
```
- WHERE event_type IN ('token','embed')
+ WHERE event_type IN ('token')
```

Maria (support): flagged two enterprise customers already asking why invoice preview shows 0.7x of expected. they want an ETA. linking support tickets: #2319, #2321.

Priya (product): we need a customer-facing line for status page and a short email template. Asha — can you draft? Keep it clear about preview discrepancy and that invoices are not final.

Asha (comms): drafting status update now. proposed: 
"We are investigating an issue affecting invoice preview accuracy for a subset of customers. Final invoices are not affected at this time. We will provide an update within 2 hours and notify customers if they need to take action."

Katie (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) roll back the 03:41 query change to re-include embed events, 2) trigger a reconciliation job to reingest missing events for window 03:30-04:30, 3) run validation and update previews. doing step 1 now.

ops-bot: deploy started by katie (oncall) — rollback to commit c3a9f2 (reinstates embed filter). ETA ~5m.

Omar (sre): i see rollback in progress on transform-worker pool. health checks passing. consumer offsets preserved.

ops-bot: deploy complete. rollbacks succeeded on all transform workers.

Jin (billing-eng): after rollback, quick sanity check: running sampling query against raw events for customer_123: 
```
SELECT count(*) FROM events_raw
WHERE customer_id = 'customer_123' AND ts >= '2026-10-21T03:30:00Z' AND ts < '2026-10-21T04:30:00Z' AND event_type IN ('token','embed');
```
Result: before rollback 814 => after rollback 1,102. that's the missing ~26% we saw. proceeding to enqueue recon job.

Omar (sre): starting recon job (replay ingest) for window 03:30-04:30 UTC; it's queued on batch-runner. estimated finish 20-30m. i'll monitor.

Maria (support): drafted a short support reply to customers on tickets: 
"Thanks for the report — we observed an issue where invoice previews underreported recent usage. We've rolled back the change causing this and are replaying events to restore preview accuracy. Final invoices are unaffected. We'll update this thread when previews are regenerated. Apologies for the confusion."

Asha (comms): status page (draft) — please review: 
- component: Billing / Invoice Preview
- status: Investigating -> Identified (root cause: incorrect event filter introduced in a recent deploy)
- impact: Invoice preview values may be lower than real-time usage for a subset of customers. Final invoices are unaffected.
- next update: in 60 minutes or when recon completes.

Priya (product): good. add a note for enterprise: "If you rely on previewed numbers for internal billing, contact support and we can provide interim reconciled reports."

Katie (oncall): internal comms template for AE/CS: 
`Short update: We found and rolled back a filter change that caused embed events to be excluded from invoice previews between 03:30-04:30 UTC. Previews are being regenerated; final invoices unaffected. Expected full recovery in ~30–45m. For customers needing immediate reconciled numbers, open a support escalation and tag @billing-eng.`

Asha (comms): preparing customer email for affected customers (subject + body): 
Subject: Temporary discrepancy in invoice previews — we are reconciling
Body: Hi — we detected an issue that caused invoice previews to underreport recent usage for some customers between 03:30–04:30 UTC. We have rolled back the change that caused this and are replaying events to restore previews. Final invoices will not be impacted. We expect previews to be corrected within the next hour. If you need an immediate reconciled usage report, reply and we'll prioritize. Sorry for the disruption.

ops-bot: status-bot update: posting public status page update (draft) -> requires Asha review.

Asha (comms): approved. posting now via status API. curl used: 
```
curl -X POST https://status.redwood.ai/api/incidents \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <STATUS_TOKEN>" \
  -d '{"component":"Billing / Invoice Preview","status":"identified","message":"We have identified the cause and are replaying events to restore preview accuracy. Final invoices unaffected."}'
```

Jin (billing-eng): recon job finished for most partitions; validation script shows previews regenerated for 85% of affected customers. running final checksum across last 24h.

Omar (sre): replay completed. consumer offsets stable. no backlog. infra side clear.

Katie (oncall): validation: comparing previews to canonical usage for random sample of 200 accounts — mean relative error now 1.8% (was 26% during issue). looks good. marking incident as mitigated.

Asha (comms): suggested public update: "Mitigated — a config change briefly excluded certain event types from invoice previews; we rolled back the change and replayed events to restore previews. Final invoices were not affected. If you still see discrepancies, please contact support." posting in 5.

Maria (support): notifying customers in tickets with updated text and link to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1790123456

Priya (product): owners: Jin + Omar for immediate RCA. Postmortem owners: Jin (billing-eng) + Katie (oncall) to collect timeline & action items.

Jin (billing-eng): action items noted: 1) add unit/regression test for event_type filter coverage, 2) add a gated schema check on deploy that alerts if any event_type values are dropped, 3) improve preview parity monitoring (daily sanity checks), 4) run a full reconciliation for invoices in last 30 days to be safe.

Katie (oncall): handing off to day shift — @omar, @jin, pls triage follow-ups. i'll update oncall notes and close this pager once RCA doc exists.

Omar (sre): acknowledged handoff. i'll set a follow-up ticket for runbook updates and link logs.

status-bot: Incident 1790123456 status: Mitigated. Root cause: deploy changed event_type filter, excluding embed events from billing pipeline.

Asha (comms): final customer-facing message published; internal exec summary queued. will share postmortem draft when ready.

Maria (support): closing customer tickets with reconciliation attachments.

Jin (billing-eng): will own the postmortem. target publish: 48 hours. adding runbook updates to backlog.

Katie (oncall): closing thread. thanks team. :raised_hands:
